title: Acoustic Open Mic @ Chef's Market
event_description: Weekly acoustic open mic night hosted by Brian Badami featuring guitarists and singer-songwriters. Sign ups begin at 5:30 PM for performances.
event_venue_information:
Chef's Market Food Hall

Venue Description

Chef's Market is a vibrant food hall and entertainment venue located in City Center at Oyster Point. The space features a brewery and distillery with craft beers and cocktails alongside food vendors offering diverse cuisine. The venue maintains an energetic atmosphere with entertainment options including duck pin bowling darts shuffleboard and arcade games.

Music Events

The venue hosts regular live music events including weekly acoustic open mic nights on Thursdays from 6:00 PM to 9:00 PM hosted by Brian Badami. The space accommodates performers of various styles and provides PA system support for performances. Weekend live music performances are also featured regularly.

Atmosphere

Chef's Market creates a lively social environment where diners can enjoy craft food and beverages while experiencing live acoustic music. The open layout and modern amenities make it an ideal location for casual performances and community musicians to showcase their talents.

title: Open Mic @ Cure Coffeehouse Newport News
event_description: Weekly open mic night featuring singer-songwriters musicians poets and performers. All performance styles welcome including folk rock alternative and experimental music. Free to attend and participate.
venue_address: 706 Town Center Drive Suite 104 Newport News VA 23606
event_venue_information:
Cure Coffeehouse

Venue Description

Cure Coffeehouse is an independent specialty coffee shop located in City Center Newport News. The venue features quality craft coffee handcrafted beverages fresh baked goods and light lunch options. The spacious comfortable atmosphere with large windows overlooking fountains creates an inviting gathering space for the community.

Open Mic Community

Cure Coffeehouse hosts a beloved weekly open mic on Thursday evenings that has become a cornerstone of the Newport News music and arts community. The event fosters inclusion and supports artists of all skill levels from seasoned performers to first-time stage participants. The open mic welcomes diverse performance styles including folk music singer-songwriter material poetry spoken word and experimental arrangements. Visual artists have opportunities to sell and exhibit work at the venue.

Inclusive Atmosphere

The venue is known for creating a warm welcoming and intentionally inclusive environment particularly for the LGBTQ+ community and emerging artists. Host Austin Milby has cultivated a supportive culture where performers and audience members feel comfortable and valued. The space celebrates local talent and serves as a gathering place for the creative community.

title: 25 Mics @ Downing-Gross Cultural Arts Center
event_description: Monthly free open mic night for musicians poets comedians and storytellers. Family-friendly event celebrating local talent. Sign ups available on a first-come-first-served basis at the event.
event_venue_information:
Downing-Gross Cultural Arts Center

Venue Description

The Downing-Gross Cultural Arts Center is a multi-purpose cultural venue housed in a historic building originally built in 1917 as the Walter Reed School. The facility has been restored and serves as a hub for arts and culture in the Southeast community of Newport News. The center features the 276-seat Ella Fitzgerald Theater named after the legendary First Lady of Song.

Event Spaces and Programs

The facility includes the Newport News Community Gallery for rotating exhibitions the Anderson Johnson Gallery with permanent folk art exhibits and meeting rooms for various events and activities. Beyond 25 Mics the center hosts visual arts exhibitions performing arts shows community events and educational programs. The space provides a professional setting for local and national artists to perform and showcase their work.

Community Focus

Downing-Gross is dedicated to promoting cultural awareness and providing opportunities for local artists and performers. The center fosters community engagement with a focus on accessibility and encourages participation from all segments of the Newport News community. The facility enhances the cultural landscape while celebrating the citys artistic heritage and contemporary creative expression.
